description: Use this when the user asks how much a wedding costs in general, or how to split a total budget. Zola's general estimate of the total cost of a wedding in a US city, state, or wedding market, for a guest count, and the typical cost of each budget category (venue, catering, photographer, and more), from Zola data. With the couple's total budget, it splits that total across the categories. Do not use to find vendors. Do not use for the couple's own budget, costs or payments: use zola_get_my_budget.

guest_count.description: Number of guests. Omit when the user did not say.

location.description: City and state (for example 'Chicago, IL'), a state ('Texas'), or a wedding market ('Long Island'). Omit for a United States estimate.

total_budget.description: The couple's own total budget, in whole US dollars, from 1,000 to 10,000,000. When given, the categories split this total.

name: zola_estimate_wedding_budget

categories.description: Typical cost of each budget category

category.description: Budget category, for example Venues or Photographers

high_cents.description: High end of the typical range, in cents

low_cents.description: Low end of the typical range, in cents

estimate_location.description: The place that the estimate is for. It can be the state or the country when Zola has no data for the requested place.

guest_count_note.description: Why the guest count of the estimate is not the requested count

location_candidates.description: The places that match the requested name, when there is more than one

label.description: Place name, for example Louisville, KY

requested_location.description: The place name that was asked for

status.description: estimate: the estimate is in this result. ambiguous_location: more than one place matches. location_not_found: Zola does not know the place.

high_cents.description: High end of the typical range, in cents

low_cents.description: Low end of the typical range, in cents

total_budget_cents.description: The couple's own total budget, in cents. When present, the categories split this total.

title: Estimate Wedding Budget
